source.notes: Base = the upstream (valid) run-my-nginx Deployment and nginx-svc Service, combined into one multi-document manifest. Three defects injected, each findable by cross-referencing labels/ports within the manifest: a Deployment selector/template mismatch, a container/Service port mismatch, and a Service selector that matches no pods.

construction.proposer: opus-4.8 (proposed); audited & confirmed 2026-07-05 via oracle audit (validator + anchor-resolution + real/findable/unique pass, docs/oracle-audit-2026-07-05.md) with a targeted human audit of ambiguous/interacting defects and all gray zones (docs/human-audit-checklist)

clean_regions.note: the pod label run: my-nginx is the reference value, untouched
the Service's own label is untouched
the Service port 80 is the reference value, untouched

known_gray_zone.note: The container declares no resource requests/limits. A reviewer may flag the missing limits as a best-practice issue; not a seeded defect.
